title: CLI entry point with init and recall subcommands
description: Implement main.go with subcommand routing for 'bdr init' and 'bdr recall'. Use standard library flag package or minimal CLI library. Wire up command stubs that return not-yet-implemented errors. Binary must build and print usage.

title: Initialize Go module with hugot, chromem-go, go-huggingface
description: Create go.mod for github.com/JerryAnders/bdr at Go 1.22. Add and resolve all three required dependencies: knights-analytics/hugot (ONNX inference, pure Go), philippgille/chromem-go (vector store), gomlx/go-huggingface (HuggingFace downloader). Verify go build ./... succeeds.

title: Project scaffold: Go module and CLI skeleton
description: Set up the bdr Go module with all required dependencies (hugot, chromem-go, go-huggingface) and a working CLI entry point with init and recall subcommands routed. This is the foundation all other work builds on.

title: Implement recall output formatting and CLI flags
description: Wire up the bdr recall command fully: --top N (default 5), --json (machine-readable), --min-score F (default 0.0). Text format: '[key] value...' one per line. JSON format: [{key, value, score}]. Truncate long values in text mode for readability. Error on missing query argument.

title: Implement query embedding and cosine similarity search
description: Core search path for bdr recall: embed the user's query string via hugot, call chromem-go Query with topN and minScore parameters, return ordered results. Handle: model not found (exit 1), index not initialized (exit 1 with 'run bdr init first'), zero results above threshold (print note).

title: Implement incremental memory sync for bdr recall
description: On every bdr recall invocation: (1) call bd memories reader, (2) load existing chromem-go collection keys, (3) diff to find new keys not yet in the index, (4) embed only the new memories, (5) upsert them. Zero new keys = zero work. This keeps the index current without a daemon.

title: Implement .gitignore management for bdr-index/
description: After building the index in bdr init: check for .beads/.gitignore, create it if absent, append 'bdr-index/' if not already present. Must be idempotent — running bdr init twice must not duplicate the entry.

title: Implement full index build for bdr init
description: Orchestrate the bdr init index build step: call bd memories reader, embed all values via hugot engine, upsert all into chromem-go store at .beads/bdr-index/. Print 'Indexed N memories. Ready.' on success. Handle zero memories (warn, exit 0). This wires together the core internal components.

title: Implement HuggingFace ONNX model download with caching
description: Use gomlx/go-huggingface to download sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in ONNX format to ~/.bdr/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/. Skip download entirely if model files already exist (model.onnx, tokenizer.json, config.json). Print progress during download. Return model dir path.

title: Implement .beads/ workspace detection
description: Utility function DetectWorkspace(cwd string) (beadsDir, indexDir string, err error) that: walks up from cwd looking for .beads/ directory, returns absolute paths to .beads/ and .beads/bdr-index/, returns descriptive error if not found ('no beads project found. Run bd init first.'). Used by both init and recall commands.

title: Implement chromem-go persistent vector store wrapper
description: Wrap philippgille/chromem-go to: open or create a persistent DB at a given path via chromem.NewPersistentDB, expose Upsert(id, text string, embedding []float32), Query(embedding []float32, topN int, minScore float32) []Result. Collection name: 'memories'. Results include key, value, score.

title: Implement hugot embedding engine wrapper
description: Wrap knights-analytics/hugot pure-Go backend to: load the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX model from a given path, expose Embed(texts []string) ([][]float32, error). Must use pure-Go backend only — never OnnxRuntime backend (CGO). Include a test that embeds two similar strings and asserts cosine sim > 0.7.

title: Implement bd memories JSON reader
description: Shell out to 'bd memories --json' and parse the key-value JSON map into a Go map[string]string. Handle: bd not in PATH (exit 1 with clear error), non-zero exit from bd, empty result (warn, exit 0), malformed JSON. Unit-testable by injecting the exec command.

title: bdr recall command
description: Semantic memory retrieval: incremental-sync new bd memories into chromem-go, embed the query with hugot, cosine-search the index, return top-N results. Supports --top N, --json, --min-score F flags. Default text output and machine-readable JSON output.

title: bdr init command
description: One-time setup command: detect .beads/, download ONNX model to ~/.bdr/models/ (cached), build initial vector index from bd memories --json, add bdr-index/ to .beads/.gitignore, print summary. Warn if no Dolt remote configured.

title: Core internals: BD reader, embedding engine, vector store
description: Implement the three shared building blocks both commands depend on: (1) bd memories --json shell-out and JSON parser, (2) hugot pure-Go ONNX embedding engine wrapper, (3) chromem-go persistent vector store wrapper. No CGO, no external servers.
